name: voice
description: Proxy to a standalone real-time STT + diarization server (Python). Bridges audio control commands and forwards transcript/speaker events to the bus.

default_subscriptions.description: Voice node control commands (e.g. enable/disable VAD, switch model). Sender pushes JSON; the Python sidecar honours it.
Rename a tracked speaker. Payload: {speaker_id, new_name}.
Merge two speaker IDs into one (manual disambiguation). Payload: {keep, drop}.
